function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL and retrieves data as specified by the parameters. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The URL to which the GET request is sent. It is expected to be a well-formed HTTP or HTTPS URL.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: The Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

headers.description: A dictionary of HTTP headers to send with the request. Each key-value pair represents a header name and its value.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up, as a float, or a (connect_timeout, read_timeout) tuple. This is a float type value.

lat.description: Latitude of the location for the query, in degrees. This is a float type value.

lon.description: Longitude of the location for the query, in degrees. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters to append to the URL for the GET request.

allow_redirects.description: Determines if HTTP redirections (301, 302, etc.) should be followed.

auth.description: A tuple representing the user credentials for HTTP authentication, typically in the form of (username, password).

cert.description: Path to an SSL certificate file to verify the peer, or a tuple of (certificate file, key file).

cookies.description: A dictionary of cookies to send with the request. The key is the cookie name and the value is the cookie value.

http.description: URL of the proxy for HTTP requests.

https.description: URL of the proxy for HTTPS requests.

proxies.description: A dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy.

stream.description: If True, the response content will not be downloaded immediately but streamed.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate or not, or a path to a CA bundle if verification is needed.

Sure! Here’s a quick rundown of places you can order a cake from—whether you’re looking for something local, a specialty bakery, or just a convenient delivery option.

| Option | What it offers | How to get it |
|--------|----------------|---------------|
| **Local bakeries** | Fresh, often custom‑made cakes; great for supporting your community. | Search “cake shop near me” on Google Maps or Yelp. Call ahead to confirm availability and place an order. |
| **Specialty bakeries** | Artisan flavors, vegan/gluten‑free options, themed designs. | Look up “artisan bakery” or “custom cake shop” in your city. Many have websites or Instagram pages where you can see their portfolio and place orders online. |
| **Online marketplaces** | Wide variety of styles, sometimes same‑day delivery. | Sites like **Etsy** let you order handmade cakes from independent bakers worldwide. |
| **Food‑delivery apps** | Quick, convenient, often same‑day service. | Use **Uber Eats**, **DoorDash**, **Postmates**, or **Grubhub**. Search for “cakes” or “desserts” in your area. |
| **Grocery delivery** | Ready‑to‑eat cakes from supermarkets. | Order through **Instacart**, **Amazon Fresh**, or your local grocery chain’s delivery service. |
| **Specialty cake delivery** | Dedicated cake‑delivery services (e.g., **Cake Delivery NYC**, **The Cake Shop**). | Many cities have local companies that specialize in cake delivery. A quick web search for “cake delivery in [your city]” will give you options. |

### Tips for ordering

1. **Plan ahead** – Custom cakes usually require at least a week’s notice. Even ready‑made cakes may run out during holidays or weekends.
2. **Check reviews** – Especially for local shops or online orders, look at recent customer feedback to gauge quality and reliability.
3. **Ask about delivery fees** – Some services charge extra for delivery or require a minimum order amount.
4. **Confirm dietary restrictions** – If you need gluten‑free, dairy‑free, or vegan options, double‑check that the bakery can accommodate those needs.
5. **Provide clear instructions** – For custom orders, include flavor, size, design details, and any special messages. For delivery, give a precise address and contact number.

If you tell me your city or zip code, I can help narrow down specific bakeries or delivery services that operate in your area. Happy cake hunting!
